0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Jazz on the road. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), who is out, and Blake Hinson (hip), Kyle Filipowski (back), and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (ankle), who is out, and has GG Jackson (ankle), Jerami Grant (rest), and Micah Peavy (ankle) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Utah's most recent meeting was a 147-101 win in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
